The '''2017–18 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team''' represented [[Texas A&M University]] in the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team's head coach [[Billy Kennedy (basketball)|Billy Kennedy]] was in his seventh season at Texas A&M. The Aggies played their home games at [[Reed Arena]] in [[College Station, Texas]] in their sixth season as members of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 22–13, 9–9 in SEC play to finish in a tie for seventh place. They lost in the second round of the [[2018 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] and defending champion [[2017–18 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen where they lost to [[2017–18 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]].

==Previous season==
The [[2016–17 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Aggies]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 16–15, 8–10 in [[2016–17 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for ninth place. They lost in the second round of the [[2017 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2016–17 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]].
